description: K₂NaNbO₂F₄ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the tetragonal P4₂/mnm space group. K is bonded to four equivalent O and eight F atoms to form KO₄F₈ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent KO₄F₈ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent KO₄F₈ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₂F₄ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent NbO₂F₄ octahedra. All K-O bond lengths are 3.06 Å. All K-F bond lengths are 3.05 Å. Na is bonded to two equivalent O and four F atoms to form NaO₂F₄ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NbO₂F₄ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent KO₄F₈ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. Both Na-O bond lengths are 2.41 Å. There are two shorter (2.27 Å) and two longer (2.29 Å) Na-F bond lengths. Nb is bonded to two equivalent O and four F atoms to form NbO₂F₄ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₂F₄ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent KO₄F₈ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. Both Nb-O bond lengths are 1.90 Å. All Nb-F bond lengths are 2.04 Å. O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four equivalent K, one Na, and one Nb atom. There are two inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four equivalent K, one Na, and one Nb atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four equivalent K, one Na, and one Nb atom.
